ssurgo_sql:
SELECT mu.mukey, co.cokey, hz.chkey, hz.hzname,
hz.ph1to1h2o_r AS ph, hz.ec_r AS ec, hz.om_r AS om_pct,
hz.pbray1_r AS p_bray1, hz.cec7_r AS cec
FROM legend AS l
INNER JOIN mapunit AS mu ON mu.lkey = l.lkey
LEFT JOIN component AS co ON co.mukey = mu.mukey
LEFT JOIN chorizon AS hz ON hz.cokey = co.cokey
WHERE l.areasymbol = 'TX157'
ORDER BY mu.mukey, co.cokey, hz.chkey
ssurgo_geo_sql:
SELECT p.mukey, p.mupolygongeo.STEnvelope().STAsText() AS envelope_wkt
FROM mupolygon AS p INNER JOIN mapunit AS mu ON mu.mukey = p.mukey
INNER JOIN legend AS l ON l.lkey = mu.lkey WHERE l.areasymbol = 'TX157'
kssl_sql:
SELECT s.site_key, p.pedon_key, p.user_pedon_id,
       l.layer_key, l.labsampnum, l.hzn_desgn AS hzname, l.hzn_top, l.hzn_bot,
       CAST(s.latitude_std_decimal_degrees AS REAL) AS latitude,
       CAST(s.longitude_std_decimal_degrees AS REAL) AS longitude,
       s.horizontal_datum_name AS original_horizontal_datum,
       c.objectid, c.result_source_key, c.prep_code, c.ph_h2o, c.ph_h2o_method, c.electrical_conductivity_satx, c.electrical_cond_satx_method, c.organic_carbon_walkley_black, c.oc_walkley_black_method, c.estimated_organic_carbon, c.phosphorus_bray1, c.phosphorus_bray1_method, c.phosphorus_mehlich_3, c.phosphorus_mehlich_3_method, c.phosphorus_mehlich3_extractable, c.mehlich_3_extractable_method, c.phosphorus_olsen, c.phosphorus_olsen_method, c.k_nh4_ph_7, c.k_nh4_ph_7_method, c.potassium_mehlich3_extractable, c.nitrate_1m_kcl, c.nitrate_1m_kcl_method
FROM lab_site AS s
JOIN lab_pedon AS p ON p.site_key = s.site_key
JOIN lab_layer AS l ON l.pedon_key = p.pedon_key
LEFT JOIN lab_chemical_properties_vw AS c ON c.layer_key = l.layer_key
WHERE CAST(s.latitude_std_decimal_degrees AS REAL) BETWEEN :south AND :north
  AND CAST(s.longitude_std_decimal_degrees AS REAL) BETWEEN :west AND :east
ORDER BY p.pedon_key, l.layer_key, c.objectid

h.chkey,h.hzdept_r,h.hzdepb_r,h.kwfact,mo.flodfreqcl

ssurgo_mlra.sql:
SELECT l.areasymbol, mu.mukey, co.cokey, hz.chkey, hz.hzname,
hz.ph1to1h2o_r AS ph, hz.ec_r AS ec, hz.om_r AS om_pct,
hz.pbray1_r AS p_bray1, hz.cec7_r AS cec
FROM legend AS l
INNER JOIN laoverlap AS lo ON lo.lkey = l.lkey AND lo.areatypename = 'MLRA'
    AND lo.areasymbol IN ('150A')
INNER JOIN mapunit AS mu ON mu.lkey = l.lkey
LEFT JOIN component AS co ON co.mukey = mu.mukey
LEFT JOIN chorizon AS hz ON hz.cokey = co.cokey
WHERE l.areasymbol <> 'US'
ORDER BY l.areasymbol, mu.mukey, co.cokey, hz.chkey
